_meta.note: Source file contains BDDS Mobile Apps Resources page content

description: All the necessary resources to design and develop mobile apps are collected here.
usage: Use section titles as retrieval anchors. Treat links marked as Bosch employee-only or Bosch internal as restricted-access references. Treat archived resources as deprecated and non-warranted.

sections.title: Figma Libraries
sections.summary: Libraries and resources for designing Bosch-branded and native mobile apps in Figma.

subsections.title: Using Figma at Bosch
rules: Using Figma at Bosch as an editor requires a license ordered through Bosch Digital.
The license requirement also applies to DEV mode.
Details and Figma administration information are documented on the Bosch Docupedia page titled Figma.

sections.title: Development demo for iOS
sections.summary: An iOS demo is available as an implementation reference for Bosch theming and native app design resources.

statements: Colors are defined by Bosch Color Tokens.
Accent Color is set with Bosch Blue 50.
Bosch Sans is defined as the font for iOS font styles.
Top Navigation adopts Bosch Sans as the font.
The Bosch Supergraphic is provided as an image.

requirements_and_notes.instruction: Accessibility guidelines must be adhered to.
System icons must be replaced by Bosch icons.

sections.title: Mobile App Kit Archive
sections.summary: The Mobile App Kit is the predecessor of the newer mobile app resources and is archived.
sections.deprecation_notice: Active development of the Mobile App Kit was discontinued in 2023. It is still available without warranty.

sections.title: Colors
sections.summary: Mobile app design follows BDDS rules, using predefined color schemes based on Bosch Color Tokens.
principles: Base mobile app color usage on Bosch Color Tokens.
Follow BDDS rules for mobile app design.

sections.title: Fonts
sections.summary: Bosch Sans is used for Bosch-branded and native apps at all font levels.
rules: Use Bosch Sans for Bosch-branded apps.
Use Bosch Sans for native apps.
Apply Bosch Sans across all font levels.

sections.title: Symbol/logotype
sections.summary: The Bosch symbol/logotype represents the Bosch company and consists of the Bosch anchor and Bosch lettering in a defined size ratio and distance.
rules: Use the Bosch anchor and Bosch lettering together as defined.
Maintain the defined size ratio between anchor and lettering.
Maintain the defined distance between anchor and lettering.
Use downloadable color versions with or without slogan as appropriate.

sections.title: Supergraphic
sections.summary: The masterbrand Supergraphic is one of the most important Bosch design elements, alongside the symbol/logotype, and acts as a seal of quality for the brand.
rules: Use the Supergraphic as a key Bosch brand design element.
Size the Supergraphic based on the size of the symbol/logotype across all formats.
Use 1/4 of the 'H' in the Bosch logotype as the standard Supergraphic height.
